name: Gakkou Nanafushigi
source:
A few years ago two girls suddenly disappeared. Younger sister was challenged to test her bravery and spend a night at school. She never returned. Older sister followed her sibling into the night school. This is a story about her experiences upon arrival.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2018/12/vn-of-month-july-2000-shoin-aruiwa.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
几年前，两名少女突然失踪。妹妹受人激将，决定在学校过夜，以此试胆，却再也没有回来。姐姐随后也走进夜晚的校园，寻找妹妹。本作讲述的，正是姐姐抵达学校后的经历。

[摘自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2018/12/vn-of-month-july-2000-shoin-aruiwa.html]vndbreview[/url]]
